rpghealthbar.config.title: RPG Health Bar
rpghealthbar.edit.title: Move HUD
rpghealthbar.edit.hint: Drag the outlined HUD to move it. Arrow keys nudge (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip:
How armor is shown.

Vanilla (default): the normal armor icons, in the row above the health bar.
Bar: a white bar, half the width of the health bar.
Hidden: armor isn't shown.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip:
How hunger is shown.

Vanilla (default): the normal hunger icons, in the row above the health bar.
Bar: an orange bar, half the width of the health bar.
Hidden: hunger isn't shown.
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip:
Unit for the numbers on the health bar.

HP (default): health points, 20 for a full vanilla health bar.
Hearts: HP divided by 2, so 10 for a full vanilla health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.absorptionDisplay.to:
How absorption (golden hearts) is written on the health bar.

Separate (default): health + absorption / max, e.g. 16+4/20.
Combined: health and absorption added together / max, e.g. 20/20.
rpghealthbar.config.moveHud.tooltip: Drag the bars, XP bar and level number to a new spot as one group, then Save. Arrow keys nudge it.
rpghealthbar.config.resetPosition.toolti: Move the HUD back to its default spot above the hotbar.
